audience: HR teams with authorized SmartHR tenant API access

useCases.title: Review employee changes
useCases.text: List employees and inspect a selected employee’s work information, status and organizational placement.

useCases.title: Understand the organization
useCases.text: Read departments, positions and business establishments to check how the organization is structured.

useCases.title: Review employee dependents and leave
useCases.text: List an employee’s dependents and maternity or childcare leave records using the token’s permissions.

useCases.title: Maintain employee and department records
useCases.text: Create an employee or update a department when requested. These tools save changes in SmartHR.
